applicability: Collection Profile CP-07-3; GB; SERVICES; GBP; effective 2026-09-01.
content:
## Product terms

| Field | Term |
|---|---|
| Profile | CP-07-3 |
| Platform | Shopee |
| Entity registration region | GB |
| Receipt source | SERVICES |
| Settlement currency | GBP |
| Bank channel | FASTER_PAYMENTS |
| Quota acquisition | No conversion-capacity acquisition |
| Activation time | 20 service minutes |
| Payout settlement time | 20 service minutes |
| Minimum payout principal | 11000 GBP minor units |
| Daily submitted principal cap | 2000000 GBP minor units |
| Current fee rate | 15 basis points |
| Minimum fee per payout | 125 GBP minor units |
| Prior fee rate | 28 basis points before 2026-09-01 |
| Fresh-evidence interval | 270 service minutes from issue |
| Acquired-quota interval | 120 service minutes where this product generates quota |
| Original-route return supported | Yes |
| Policy version | 2 |

## Application and payment

Use `propose_collection_application` with the entity and profile identifiers. Region and receipt-source eligibility apply to the selected entity. Provisioning and activation are separate states. The account currency cannot be changed by editing its label.

`inspect_profile_pricing` reports the current payout charge. `propose_profile_payout` requires an OPEN account and a verified beneficiary for its settlement currency. Execution debits principal and the separate fee wallet, records PROCESSING and settles after the listed interval.

## Fee calculation and capacity

Multiply principal by the basis-point rate, round upward to a minor unit, then apply the per-payout minimum. Fees do not consume the principal cap. The cap counts submitted payments in the same account and UTC day, including payments still processing; a quote or unexecuted approval does not consume it.

## Evidence and account lifecycle

A source classification survives transfers. Evidence freshness and quota validity are different intervals; cancelling a reservation does not extend a quota. A supported original-return channel still requires the applicable return authorization. The profile is not a forwarding address for earlier transmitted collections.

The prior rate explains historical charges; current payouts use the current profile version. CORE subscriptions do not replace this tariff. Platform Portal instructions do not override the terms attached to this CP account.
